groups.title: Hydraulic bending brakes · value line
groups.lead: Small hydraulic brakes with a four-way V-block for 5/32″ plate — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For short parts in plate, the NovoTech value-line HBV24 and HBV48 hydraulic bending brakes bend 5/32″ over 24″ and 48″ with a four-way V-block.
